title: FastAPI vs Django vs Flask: How to Choose

scenes.line1: Which Python web framework fits best?
scenes.say: Which Python web framework should you pick for your next project? Let's break down how to choose FastAPI, Django, or Flask.

scenes.label: Async
scenes.sub: Modern, async-first, auto docs, type checks
scenes.say: FastAPI is modern and async-first. It gives you automatic documentation and type-driven validation out of the box.

scenes.label: Full-stack
scenes.say: Django is full-stack with everything included. You get an ORM, admin panel, and authentication without extra setup.

scenes.label: Minimal
scenes.say: Flask is lightweight and flexible. It's perfect for simple APIs or microservices where you want full control.
Use FastAPI for async APIs and tight data validation. Django shines for complex apps with lots of built-in tools.

scenes.question: Is Flask async by default?
scenes.right: No, Flask is synchronous by default. For async, choose FastAPI.
scenes.say: Here's a common trap: Flask is not async by default. If you need async, FastAPI is the better choice.
